review: W10 independent operation-manager primitive review with root repair follow-up
scope: Read-only standalone review of js/spb-ai-operation.js using its CommonJS-exported API and fake descriptors. No pro-AI integration, native behavior, provider behavior, or live paint behavior is claimed.

source_history.baseline_before_repair: The original frozen oracle had 7/9 checks pass. The two misses were path-only same-path reload identity and mutable readDocument object aliasing.
source_history.review_correction: During follow-up, I had added an initial-current-true assertion to the frozen path-only reload case after the oracle was established. Root correctly identified that this changed the original case. I removed that added assertion and restored the frozen case to its original post-reload stale check. The path-only startup refusal is now a separately labeled post-review API-boundary observation, not frozen-oracle credit.

test.result: PASS 11/11 total: 9/9 frozen independent-oracle checks, 1/1 separately labeled post-review path-only fail-closed observation, and 1/1 separately labeled root collection-token regression.
coverage: cancel A, start B, then late A publication/restoration/cancel cleanup eligibility
same logical request entering a repair-turn collection generation; old and post-ready result gates
same-path source reload with and without a reported generation
preview restore after a later manual revision
stale publication after a newer owner starts
root-supplied regression for two collection generations on one request ticket
test.limitations: The API is exercised directly. A tiny consumer-side callback gate uses collecting(ticket, collection) to test the primitive; no actual model tool callback, dispatcher, editor controller, renderer, or native UI is invoked.

repaired_behavior.verdict: frozen oracle passes; path-only caller is separately confirmed fail-closed
repaired_behavior.evidence: The manager snapshots descriptor fields at start and validDocument requires finite numeric sourceGeneration or generation before sameDocument/current succeeds (js/spb-ai-operation.js:11-26).
repaired_behavior.probe: Fresh snapshots with the same path but generation 4→5 invalidate the old ticket and refuse publication. The restored frozen path-only test changes a path-only descriptor at the same path and observes current(ticket) false after reload. Separately, a post-review boundary observation confirms the ticket is already non-current immediately after start when no generation is provided.
repaired_behavior.integration_contract: The controller must supply its actual monotonic source-load generation (and relevant source/canvas identity) in every document snapshot. Path alone fails closed; this review did not verify real controller wiring.

repaired_behavior.evidence: The manager shallow-copies document fields into a ticket snapshot (js/spb-ai-operation.js:11-15).
repaired_behavior.probe: When readDocument returns one mutable object and sourceGeneration changes in place from 1 to 2, current(ticket) becomes false. This was a counterexample before repair and passes after repair.

repaired_behavior.evidence: The manager exposes collect(ticket); collecting/ready accept an optional collection token (js/spb-ai-operation.js:44-46).
repaired_behavior.probe: The additional root-supplied test keeps one request ticket, opens collection generations 2 then 3, rejects late collection-2 append/ready, and accepts generation 3. The frozen test also proves a new turn ticket invalidates an earlier ticket.
repaired_behavior.integration_contract: The dispatcher must allocate a collection token for each provider/tool turn, including repair turns; bind results to that token and gate callbacks with collecting(ticket, token), not current(ticket) alone. The primitive does not intercept callback mutations itself.

confirmed_standalone_passes: Cancel A then start B: late A publish and restore are refused; stale A cancel returns false and leaves B current.
When sourceGeneration is part of a fresh identity snapshot, same-path reload invalidates the old ticket.
Path-only descriptors fail closed because they cannot provide reload identity.
In-place document descriptor mutation is detected after the repair snapshots fields.
Replacing elementRef while path and index remain stable invalidates the old ticket.
After preview publication advances the expected revision, a later manual revision causes restore to refuse without invoking its callback.
A stale ticket cannot publish after a newer ticket takes ownership.
The new collection token rejects old callbacks and old ready signals within the same request.
not_claimed: No production integration into js/spb-pro-ai.js was present or tested in this review.
No claim is made about real tool callbacks, actual controller generation wiring, canvas/layer revisions, preview restore effects, document loading, or native UI correctness.
